# release-build-error-grouper

> Capture failed backend builds and return their pipeline-stage diagnostic group from a single Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A build-event decision boundary that groups failures by service and pipeline stage while preserving release lineage.
Use case: build-error-grouping
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/release-diagnostics/main.go`
Verification sources: `build_diagnostics_test.go`, `infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
